c74object.name: j.model
c74object.description: j.model is the central brain in a jamoma model. It parses input, distributes messages to parameters, generates documentation, etc.

method.name: init
method.description: The init message initializes this model. This message is implemented as a j.message embedded in the j.model object

attribute.name: amenities
attribute.digest: Allow to select j.model's provided services
attribute.description: The amenities attribute selects j.model's provided services to specific needs. The amenities attribute can be set as an argument to its patcher. It will then override amenities defined within the model.

attribute.name: description
attribute.digest: A textual description of the model for auto-documentation purposes
attribute.description: The description attribute sets a textual description of the model for auto-documentation purposes

attribute.name: priority
attribute.digest: The priority of the model - used for preset and cue management
attribute.description: The priority attribute sets the priority of the model. It allows to define the order in which model will be saved/recalled from preset and cue. The priority attribute can be set as an argument to its patcher. It will then override priority defined within the model.
